summary.text: William Lawrence is the Democratic nominee and a climate and housing organizer making his first run for office. He co-founded the Sunrise Movement and later helped found tenant-organizing groups in mid-Michigan. He won the August 2026 Democratic primary and, according to his campaign website, is running on housing affordability, Medicare for All and climate action.

paragraphs.text: Born in 1990 in Madison, Wisconsin, he moved to East Lansing at age five and graduated from East Lansing High School, according to Wikipedia; his campaign website also says he was raised in East Lansing.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Swarthmore College (sociology and anthropology, per Wikipedia).
Co-founded the Sunrise Movement, a youth climate organization, in 2015; he worked there as development director and later director of strategic partnerships and left in 2020, per Wikipedia.

Since 2020 has worked on housing issues in Michigan; he founded the Mid-Michigan Tenant Resource Center and helped found the Michigan Rent Is Too Damn High Coalition, which his campaign website says has won statewide protections for low-income renters.
Won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for Michigan's 7th District, defeating Bridget Brink and Matt Maasdam. This is his first run for Congress.
According to his campaign website, he and his wife live in Lansing.
